entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Mark Cole. Order number is 9F-2187.
Thank you, Mark. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band?
The pulse rate is completely wrong. It's off by 20 or 30 beats. The thing is garbage.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. Is it a technical fault you're seeing, or more of a preference on how the data is displayed?
It's a fault. Look, I don't have time to play twenty questions. I just want my money back. Are you going to process the refund or not?
I understand. For a defect claim, the standard procedure is to connect you with our technical support team to troubleshoot the device. They can verify the issue and...
No. I don't want support. I don't have time for that. I tried it, it doesn't work, and I want a refund. It's a simple request.
Okay, Mark, I hear your frustration. Let me just check the return eligibility based on your delivery date. Please hold on for just a moment.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I've pulled up our policy, and it looks like items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Since you received your VeloBand on December 15th, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and approve this return for you now.
Okay. Good. So what's next?

I have just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file for you. Simply package the band in its original box, apply the label, and drop it off at a post office. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
